description: Switch between your pinned threads in one click from the empty title bar strip at the top of the BB window. Each chip carries a status dot for the thread and its child threads: yellow waits for you, blue works, green finished and unread. A colored bar marks the thread with its project color when Chat Sidebar by Evgeniy Perin is installed, which we recommend, and with its provider's color otherwise. Hover a chip to unpin it in place. Needs the BB desktop app; no account or network access.
